column1: # Memory-tuning source of truth for the fleet.
# One row per node, tab-separated. apply.sh reads this and writes a single
# canonical systemd drop-in per service, then applies the cgroup limits to the
# A dash (-) means the service does not run on that node; its drop-in is left
# untouched. Limits carry a soft reclaim step: High < Max. Max stays below the
# node's MemAvailable (see the spec) — a limit above available RAM is a fake
# fuse, the node OOMs before the cgroup counts that high.
# Snapshot: 2026-08-24. ws Max awaits a week of fleetwatch peaks before any
# further change; exit-node ss was widened (no ws to share with).
